findings.title: Conflation of computing certificates with certified training
assumptions: Fixed neural network and bounded input region
Sound interval propagation, no special training premise
findings.check: Explicit ReLU network on[1/10,3/10] gives logits0 lower7/10>logits1 upper3/10; Xu2020 separates graph analysis and robust training.
findings.impact: False categorical prerequisite in background comparison; no demonstrated dependence of central non-implication or norm conversion.
findings.alternative: Practical usefulness or tightness often benefits from specialized training; that is a qualified claim.
findings.repair_status: Correct separation verified analytically and in primary reference; no author adoption.

findings.title: Incorrect recency of non-ReLU certification
assumptions: Passage addresses applicability beyond ReLU without narrower architecture qualification
findings.check: CROWN2018 Section3.2 and Table5 demonstrate certification for tanh,sigmoid,arctan.
findings.impact: Historical/capability comparison inaccurate; no demonstrated failure of core security distinction.
findings.alternative: A narrower Shi2023-specific improvement may be intended but is unstated.
findings.repair_status: Earlier applicability source verified; exact intended newer advance remains to be specified.

scope_clarifications: Theorem1 is a non-implication, not zero statistical information in every population.
Theorem2 concerns coverage and potential attacks, not guaranteed existence for every model.
Certified-radius lower bounds need not equal exact boundary distance.
Security-harm concerns are conditional on access and deployment behavior.
unresolved: Whether authors intended a narrower architecture/tightness statement
